matchupOfTheWeek.title: Rush Offense vs. Run Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our rush offense grades in the 81st percentile against a unit that grades 29th — the widest real statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's a matchup that actually has some real meat on the bone: our run game is operating at an elite level — 81st percentile — and we're going up against Jacksonville's run defense, which grades out at just 29th. That's the widest edge on the entire slate this week, which means if we're serious about winning, we have a blueprint. The Jaguars' defense is solid overall (9th in the league), and their offense has been respectable at 12th, but that middle-of-the-pack rush defense is the string we need to pull. Jacksonville's come in a touch cool lately, averaging just 0.16 net EPA per play over their last three, so the window is there. The line has us at plus-2.5, which feels reasonable for a road game where we have a clear schematic advantage — this is one where execution and staying true to our strength matters most.
